List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

(Ministries: Culture; Development of North-Eastern Region; Human Resource

Total number of questions—20
Kendriya Vidyalaya in Buxar
†*161. SHRI BASHISTHA NARAIN
SINGH: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the construction stage
of the Kendriya Vidyalaya building situated
in Buxar, Bihar;
(b) whether it is a fact that the above
school is running in little space lacking in
basic facilities for the students;
(c) the action being taken to upgrade
this school to the Senior Secondary level;
and
(d) the measures being taken to make
arrangements for computer class,
playground and other necessary facilities?
Discrimination of minorities
*162. SHRIMATI BIMBA RAIKAR:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the National Minority
Commission has alleged that minorities are
discriminated against by the academic bodies
like UGC, CBSE and AICTE in the matter
of reservations in  educational institutions
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi
and also in employment in educational
bodies/institutions;
(b) if so, whether Government would
consider bringing in a legislation for
reservation of minority communities both
for admission into/employment in the
educational bodies/colleges; and
(c) whether Government have also
proposed strengthening of  madarsa system
of education for minorities by providing
them funds to modernize the infrastructure
and curriculum?
Children out of school
*163. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
out of 200 million children in the age group
of 6 to 14 years, only 120 million are in
schools;
(b) if so, the steps Government are
taking to ensure their attendance in schools;
(c) whether the necessary infrastructure
could be created from the existing financial
resources; and
(d) if so, the time-frame thereof?

52
Natural heritage sites
*164. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
include the ecologically sensitive Western
Ghats in the exclusive club of World
Heritage Sites;
(b) if so, the number of the natural
heritage sites which have been identified so
far in the country; and
(c) whether any preliminary surveys
have been conducted by UNESCO to fulfil
the required parameters?
Education for girl child
*165. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to provide free education from
VI to XII to every girl from a ‘single child
family’ in schools affiliated to CBSE;
(b) whether it is also a fact that UGC is
also planning to launch a postgraduate
scholarship for girls who have come from
‘single child family’;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) the sources from where his Ministry
is going to pool the resources for
implementation of these two schemes; and
(e) whether his Ministry can think of
getting some money from Prathmik Shiksha
Kosh for this purpose?
Programmes for street children
*166. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
conducted any survey on the number of
street children living Below Poverty Line
in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
(c) whether Government have taken or
propose to take any steps for imparting
proper education and for the welfare of
these students;
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
achievements made/proposed to be made
thereon;
(e) whether Government have taken
note of the developments in this regard in
other countries; and
(f) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Action against fake universities
†*167. SHRI UDAY PRATAP
SINGH: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have issued
any directions for closure of fake
universities/educational institutes running
in different States and for taking action
against the managers of such universities/
educational institutes; and
(b) if so, the States that have taken action
to close these fake universities and also
those where such institutes are still in
operation?
Shifting of Government offices
*168. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
URBAN DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to shift Government offices from
the National Capital to the NCR;

prepared any action plan in this regard;

List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

(Ministries: Culture; Development of North-Eastern Region; Human
Resource Development; Information and Broadcasting; Law and
Justice; Mines; Parliamentary Affairs; Social Justice and
Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Urban Development;
Urban Employment and Poverty Alleviation)
Total number of questions —155
Development of Hampi
1200. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Karnataka Government has
placed Rs. 572 crore proposal before the
Japan Bank for International Co-operation
for development of Hampi, a world heritage
site; and
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government
to get the above proposal approved by the
Japan Bank for International Co-operation?
Workshop organised by IGNCA
1201. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the IGNCA has organised a
five-day workshop in Delhi alongwith the
National Research Laboratory for
Conservation of Cultural Property to train
people in various cultural institutes to
ensure that old photographs remain picture-
perfect;
(b) if so, the details of the discussions
held in the meeting; and
(c) the conclusions arrived at so far?
Ancient monuments
1202. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of ancient monuments
discovered/located in the country State-
wise during the last one year;
(b) the details of such monuments
located in Uttar Pradesh with locations
thereof;
(c) the expected age/life/period of such
monuments; and
(d) the financial assistance released for
proper maintenance thereof, State-wise
particularly to Uttar Pradesh?

276
Conservation of heritage sites in
Delhi
†1203. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that out of the
heritage sites across the country, including
seven forts and fifty two gates in Delhi,
only thirteen sites dating back to the
eleventh and twelfth centuries stand in
ruined condition;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether Government propose to
look after their upkeep by way of extending
cooperation and financial assistance to the
States and if so, the action being taken in
this regard?
Establishment of cultural centres
†1204. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to establish Indian cultural centres in foreign
countries;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Preservation of photographs
1205. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that condition of
the photographs in various collections is
not good;
(b) if so, whether Government have any
proposal to train the people to keep this
precious legacy of the past;
(c) if so, the steps taken in this direction;
(d) the number of the photographs
which are not in good condition;
(e) whether it is also a fact that there are
very few trained people in this field;
(f) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(g) the steps being taken by
Government to train the people for keeping
these photographs alive?
Role of NSD
1206. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the National School of
Drama has played very significant role in
strengthening drama and theatre in India;
(b) whether there is a plan to open a
few such schools in different parts of the
country; and
(c) if so, details thereof and if not, the
reasons therefor?
Fund for renovation and maintenance
of temples
1207. SHRI SU. THIRUNAVUKKA-
RASAR: Will the Minister of CULTURE
be pleased to state the number of temples
under his Ministry and the amount allotted
for renovation and maintenance of these
temples during 2004-05 and 2005-06?
Heritage monuments in Rajasthan
1208. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of CULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the heritage monuments (State/
National) identified in Rajasthan;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

277
(b) the monuments managed by the
Archaeological Survey of India;
(c) whether Government have any
comprehensive heritage legislation to
regulate unauthorized encroachments and
urbanizations in such areas;
(d) if so, its details and salient features
thereof; and
(e) if not, whether any proposal is under
Government's consideration to introduce
any effective legislation to regulate and
preserve such monuments of historical
importance?
Orang-Mazbat-Rupa road

the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF

improvement and repair of Orang-Mazbat-
Rupa road in Assam area;
(b) whether Orang-Dalgaon road will
be taken up for improvement and
construction of bridge during the Eleventh
